plan.notes: Source: https://www6.austincc.edu/cms/site/www/awardplans/programmap.php?ap=10170&aos=DACOS&yr=2027 (official ACC Program Map, 2026-2027 College Credit Catalog, 'Computer Science Associate of Science Degree (AS)', School of Computer Science & Information Technology). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the page's semester-by-semester program plan for full-time students. Catalog year set to 2026-2027 (the catalog the page belongs to). Caveats: (1) Official program total is 60-62 SCH because the two Life and Physical Sciences slots are each 3-4 SCH; this file models the 60-SCH path (3-SCH science courses). Choosing 4-SCH science courses raises the total to 62. (2) Both Life and Physical Sciences courses must be from the same discipline (ASTR, BIOL, CHEM, GEOL, or PHYS), per the plan's advising note. (3) MATH 2413 official prerequisite: MATH 2412 with minimum grade C OR satisfactory score on the ACC Higher Level Mathematics Placement Test. (4) COSC 2325 official prerequisite: 'Two semesters of programming or instructional program approval' - mapped here to COSC 1336 + COSC 1337, the two programming courses in this plan. (5) ENGL 1301 requires TSI complete in reading and writing or exemption (TSI placement requirement, not a course prerequisite). (6) First-semester slot: all first-time ACC students with fewer than 12 SCH must take the HUMA 1301 topic course Great Questions seminar or EDUC 1300 in their first semester; other students may choose the HUMA 1301 topic course, EDUC 1300, or a speech course from the Component Area Option core list. (7) The degree is designed for transfer to a BS in Computer Science; ACC advises choosing a transfer destination by 24 SCH.
